title: Unbounded open restriction of derived condensed-module direct image
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of positive characteristic different from $\ell$; all schemes below are separated of finite type over $k$ and all maps are $k$-morphisms [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\Lambda$ be admissible [sk-def-localizing-closure], with the finite-subextension condensed ring of [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed] for $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Use ordinary unbounded module-object derived categories and total derived pushpull [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], and exact termwise open extension by zero [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek]. Let $r:W\to\overline Y$ be a morphism, $i:Y\hookrightarrow\overline Y$ a quasi-compact open immersion, $U=W\times_{\overline Y}Y$, and $j:U\hookrightarrow W$, $p:U\to Y$ the projections [def-pc-fibre-product; def-weil-open-immersion]. On these unbounded derived categories the exact open adjunctions descend to $D(i_!)\dashv D(i^*)$ and $D(j_!)\dashv D(j^*)$, with invertible units $\eta_i,\eta_j$ induced termwise by the sheaf adjunctions. The open base-change isomorphism $r^*i_!\simeq j_!p^*$ induces the natural isomorphism $$\rho_B:i^*Rr_*B\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_*j^*B\qquad(B\in D(W_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\Lambda))$$ characterized by the natural chain $$\operatorname{Hom}(T,i^*Rr_*B)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(i_!T,Rr_*B)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(r^*i_!T,B)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(j_!p^*T,B)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(p^*T,j^*B)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(T,Rp_*j^*B).$$ The units, the adjunction Hom bijections and $\rho$ are compatible with the canonical shift identifications. No properness of $r$ and no boundedness or constructibility of $B$ or $T\in D(Y_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\Lambda)$ are assumed.

source.place: Proof (2), first sentence: restriction commutes with derived direct image, with exact open adjunction and shift normalization.
